opening.argument: The segment has the form and substance of financial reporting. Its broadcast title, interview subject and station graphics frame an examination of Bitcoin, while the narration reports one miner’s results at the time of an interview and discusses how the price changes over time. The profit figure is presented as a historical, interview-based claim, not as an offer to viewers. Nothing in the supplied frames or narration directs viewers to pay, surrender credentials or join an earning scheme; there is no explicit call to action or pathway to participate.

citations.quote: At the moment of the interview, a bitcoin was worth $ 812 which means that Vlad Mandiuc made $ 116 in 2 days
This is the evolution of price, per hour, per day and so on, per minute
